title: Model stream blocks forever on a dead TCP connection: no read timeout
note: Half-open TCP socket after a network drop hung a session 27 min; provider sets no idle timeout; fake providers cannot produce a dead socket.

title: A thread exits during the idle-session benchmark's first run, failing the release job's self-check on main
note: Unnamed models.dev refresh thread ran in the idle window; the benchmark runs only in the main-only release job, and docs/performance.md already required zero idle activity.

title: Main red on macOS: resuming a delegate whose workspace is gone reports 'recorded workspace does not match' since #4847
note: String compare of /var vs /private/var workspace paths failed only on macOS; PR runs lacked the macOS leg and the test already existed.

title: Hub sends nothing when a session's process exits after bind and before session_started
note: Found by a mutants run on another PR; the hub never reports a child exiting between bind and session_started, so clients hang; fix PR still open.

title: budget-bounds can't read fakes::WHOLE_SUBSYSTEM_WITHIN
note: xtask budget-bounds check rejected a constant the testing doc requires; tooling fault, not shipped product.

title: Approvals: should Space approve, as the overlay controls rule says?
note: Doc said Space acts like Enter but code ignored Space in approvals; owner chose to carve approvals out in docs; fix PR changed docs/tui.md only.

title: docs/model-routing.md: 'no other CI job fetches' reads as contradicted by scheduled jobs that fetch
note: Doc sentence about which CI job fetches was ambiguous or stale; wording fix only.

title: Docs contradict on stress evidence form: testing.md stress-count vs running.md 30 load-checked runs
note: Two testing docs gave different stress-run requirements; one-line doc fix.

title: fiber-home-paths: a ; in an array return type hides the fn, and failures omit the derived context
note: xtask rule parser took a semicolon inside an array return type as the signature end; tooling fault found by a lane.

title: Other origin refusals for host calls still carry invalid_arguments or closing
note: Host-call refusals by origin carried error codes that say something false; docs/errors.md documented closing; follow-up to a ruling on another ticket.

title: Process extensions: manifest process.program joins the package without an escape check
note: A ../ manifest process.program escaped the package directory, though docs/extensions.md applies the package-relative rule to it; scoped out of another PR.

title: Resume resets the consecutive-block count, so the 3-consecutive limit restarts
note: Resume seeded consecutive blocks to 0 while session blocks were restored; docs/permissions.md promises 3 consecutive; found in another ticket's confirm round.

title: Main's release build doesn't compile since #4789: RestoredLivenessEvent is debug-only
note: Code gated on debug_assertions broke the release profile; PR CI and tests build debug only, so only the main-only release job saw it.

title: A session's first idle window has a thread exit and reads 80 MB: likely the models.dev refresh
note: Idle benchmark run 1 saw an unnamed thread exit and high RSS; benchmarks run only on main; closed not planned, folded into the RSS ticket.

title: /settings: tui.panel.cards opens the documented checklist of cards and widgets
note: docs/tui.md promises a cards checklist but /settings opens a generic string list with no source of cards; found while planning another ticket; still open.

title: Main's release binary is over 26 MiB since #4772
note: Release size limit breached by 3 KB after an extensions change; the job runs only on main; resolved by raising the limit, no behaviour was wrong.

title: A broken pipe on attach or session output ends quietly
note: Attach and session copy handled BrokenPipe and other write errors wrongly against a contract ruled on a sibling ticket; no doc had set it.

title: skills: with the workspace at the parent of Fiber home, personal skills are also read as repository skills
note: Workspace equal to the parent of Fiber home made the same directory both Repository and Personal source; doc only ranked the sources and did not cover overlap.

title: An inner host.tool result too big for the Lua memory cap fails the outer call instead of returning to the script
note: Oversized inner result failed the whole outer call instead of resuming the script, contradicting extensions.md; found by a lane during diagnosis.

title: models-dev: triage OpenCode Go catalog drift in thinking table
note: Seven table rows named models that live models.dev marked deprecated or dropped; catalog drift, handled with the sibling skip-deprecated fix.

title: Memory budgets fail on Linux since the models.dev merge (#4714)
note: Holding the parsed models.dev catalogue raised idle RSS about 60 MiB; budget benchmarks run only in the main-only release job.

title: reviewer: send privilege escalation to stage 2 and block machine-wide changes beyond a named user-level route
note: Reviewer model allowed sudo apt-get at stage 1 and pip --break-system-packages at stage 2; no consent fixture covered these cases; fix proved by live sweeps.

title: models-dev: a model models.dev deprecates fails the run on the table rows that still name it
note: Upstream deprecation of a model broke the xtask generator on stale table rows; catalog drift in tooling, fix skips deprecated entries with a note.
